description:
I’m Ashitosh, an Engineering Admission and Career Counsellor committed to helping students choose the right path after 12th.
I guide students in college and branch selection across Maharashtra based on their rank, interests, and future plans.
My support includes clear cutoff analysis, CAP round strategy, and careful option filling to ensure no opportunities are missed.
I believe in practical advice, honest communication, and keeping the process easy to understand.
My goal is to help students move forward with confidence and clarity in their admission journey.
